items.evidence: "the heavy snow" is a noun phrase, requiring a prepositional connector like "Because of".
"the report is lengthy" is a full clause containing a subject and verb, requiring the conjunction "Although".
Conditional clause introduced by "if" matches "you encounter any technical problems".
"The office windows" is plural and acts as the receiver of the action; present passive "are cleaned" is correct.
Modal verb "must" is followed by the passive infinitive "be changed".
Action occurred prior to another past event ("changed last week"), requiring past perfect passive "had been sent".
Modal verb "will" must be followed by the base verb form "deliver".
The noun "shipment" matches the context of signing for delivered goods.
"by 4 p.m. today" indicates the deadline by which to contact them.
"We look forward to completing your delivery" fits naturally as a closing sentence before the sign-off.
